regionalGapSummary.freshwater: The four 1933 Pansipit River GBIF specimens support historical locality evidence only. Tayabas River remains a strong historical study lead, but the original species table and article-specific reuse terms remain unverified. Laguna de Bay's NFRDI-LLDA assessment is a future source opportunity, not current data.
regionalGapSummary.marine: The full NFRDI Manila Bay trawl paper is acquired and reviewed, including a historic Cavite-group table summary; item-specific reuse rights and station georeferencing remain open, so zero species assertions are admitted. Balayan/Calatagan remains a metadata/poster lead. A 2020-2022 NFRDI Batangas Bay poster now provides a held ten-taxon source lead; its no-ranking footer and missing item-specific reuse terms prevent app admission. An exact GBIF Batangas Bay fish-locality query returned zero and is retained only as a bounded gap.
regionalGapSummary.brackishEstuarine: The five existing held leads still yield zero admitted assertions. No new source in this sweep verifies fish identities joined to measured station salinity under reusable terms.
regionalGapSummary.smallLakesWetlandsReservoirs: A historical survey source now covers all seven named San Pablo crater lakes, but item-specific reuse rights block per-lake species rows. The 2022 Caliraya/Lumot abstract has been checked in an alternate volume PDF; it still lacks the complete species table and exact field dates, with all-rights-reserved terms. A 2014 Tikub Lake fish survey is now identified for the Ticub/Tikub scope lead, but item-specific rights are unverified and its table remains held. The bounded Caliraya/Lumot GBIF check found four copepod specimens at Caliraya and no fish record in that result; the Lumot exact-name searches and Ticub/Tikub string queries returned zero. Reservoir coverage remains open.
